papers.title: Corrosion Behaviour and Residual Stress State of Laser-Welded Ti6Al4V/AA7075 Joints with a Ag Interlayer
papers.abstract: In this study, the corrosion performance and near-surface residual stress state of laser-welded Ti6Al4V/AA7075 dissimilar joints produced with a silver (Ag) interlayer are investigated. Potentiodynamic polarization, cyclic polarization, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) were carried out on Ti6Al4V base alloy (BA), AA7075 BA, and the fusion zone (FZ) containing the Ag interlayer. The Ag interlayer FZ exhibits an intermediate but clearly improved corrosion response compared with AA7075 BA, with a corrosion potential Ecorr ≈ 0.260 V, corrosion current density icorr ≈ 4.55 × 10−6 A cm−2, and polarization resistance Rp ≈ 7.08 kΩ cm2. EIS fitting further indicates a charge-transfer resistance of Rct ≈ 3.7 × 104 Ω cm2 and a moderate oxide film resistance, consistent with a more stable electrochemical interface than AA7075 BA in 3.5 wt.% NaCl. Additionally, the residual stress measurements reveal that the Ag interlayer joint develops a predominantly compressive residual stress field on both sides of the weld. This compressive state is beneficial for delaying pit-to-crack transition and enhancing durability under corrosive loading. A brief comparison with our previously published Ti6Al4V/AA7075 welds produced using a Cu interlayer under the same laser welding parameters and joint configuration as the present study shows that the Ag interlayer provides more favourable compressive residual stresses and a more noble, higher-resistance electrochemical response.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究激光焊接Ti6Al4V/AA7075异种接头的腐蚀和残余应力，非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not concern additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it investigates laser-welded dissimilar joints of Ti6Al4V and AA7075, not additive manufacturing processes such as LPBF, SLM, EBM, or DED.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究银中间层对激光焊接Ti6Al4V/AA7075异种接头腐蚀行为和残余应力的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过动电位极化、循环极化和电化学阻抗谱测试腐蚀性能，并用X射线衍射测量残余应力。
summary_zh.result: 含银中间层的熔合区腐蚀性能优于AA7075，且残余压应力有利于抑制裂纹萌生。
summary_zh.validation: 实验结果与铜中间层接头对比，验证了银中间层的优越性。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the corrosion behavior and residual stress state of laser-welded Ti6Al4V/AA7075 dissimilar joints using a silver interlayer.
summary_en.method: Potentiodynamic polarization, cyclic polarization, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy were employed to evaluate corrosion resistance, while X-ray diffraction measured near-surface residual stresses.
summary_en.result: The fusion zone with the Ag interlayer exhibited intermediate corrosion response superior to AA7075, and a predominantly compressive residual stress field beneficial for delaying pit-to-crack transition.
summary_en.validation: Comparisons with previously published Cu-interlayer joints validated the improved electrochemical and stress performance of the Ag interlayer.
